inputProvenance: Start images are original Phobos procedural drawings (Fennmark colours) or first passes of this record; no game or third-party imagery uploaded. Start drawings were sent base64, first passes by their PixelLab download URL; all are retained under references/ with hashes here.

nickel-iron-ingot.method: per-pixel luminance map onto a warm iron ramp; alpha and pixel placement unchanged

rejectedArchive: Nothing archived: every unselected output is a retained generation input of a selected one.

request.description: ORTHOGRAPHIC VERTICAL OVERHEAD PLAN VIEW. Camera directly above, looking straight down at the object's TOP SURFACE ONLY. Rectangular edges run horizontally and vertically on the canvas. Show no vertical front or side faces. The whole square canvas is the top of a compact spacecraft volatiles refinery installed in a square frame: a dark graphite painted steel frame with burnt-orange corner clamps around a pale sand-coloured steel deck plate lit from the upper left; upper left a large round hearth lid in dark graphite with a bolted rim and a small glowing orange sight port in its centre; upper right the top of a horizontal steel drying retort drum with two copper bands; lower left a square graphite charge hatch with one straight orange handle bar; lower right a recessed dark output tray with thin horizontal grille slats; a copper water outlet stub on the right frame; two small dark orange power sockets on the left frame; a few scuffs and rivet dots. Utilitarian retro spaceship equipment: crisp dark outlines, small readable colour regions, restrained shading, sparse purposeful details, a little wear. No perspective, no ground shadow, no pipes leaving the frame, no text, numbers, symbols or logos.

attempts.review: Overhead and on-family but flat (nine colours) and the retort drum reads as a barred box; retained on main as the input of the selected second pass.

request.description: ORTHOGRAPHIC VERTICAL OVERHEAD PLAN VIEW. Camera directly above, looking straight down at the object's TOP SURFACE ONLY. Rectangular edges run horizontally and vertically on the canvas. Show no vertical front or side faces. Draw one small block of refined carbon stock seen from directly above: a single horizontal rounded rectangular graphite briquette, matte charcoal black with a faint dark-grey sheen and a few tiny lighter grey flecks along the upper-left edge, slightly rounded corners, a subtle pressed groove across the middle. Clearly clean industrial carbon stock, not coal ore, not food. Original coarse pixel art, three-tone shading, utilitarian spaceship workshop stock. Centre the complete silhouette on a transparent 64 x 64 canvas with 8-pixel side margins; intended native export 16 x 16. No perspective, no side walls, no scene, no ground shadow, no text, letters or logos.

attempts.review: Overhead but too dark to read against the game's dark inventory background at 16 px; retained on main as the input of the selected second pass.
